findings: Duplicate string literals (DRY / Bounded proxy): naive=19, dropping to 1 at treatment-v3. Control (expert prompting, no GS) achieves only 5 — less than naive, but still 3x higher than GS treatment-v3.

Cyclomatic complexity does not monotonically track treatment level. v4/v5 have more branch-heavy functions than earlier conditions; this is attributable to greater functional completeness — richer error-handling paths produce higher cyclomatic scores.
No condition exceeds cognitive complexity threshold 10 in any function. AI-generated code across all conditions produces mentally manageable function bodies regardless of specification quality.
No identical functions detected in any condition across all 7 implementations. Every function has a distinct body — AI generation does not produce copy-paste duplication.

treatment-v2 duplicate string regression (10 vs treatment-v1 at 3) warrants investigation; likely attributable to configuration-adjacent string literals introduced in that condition's authentication middleware.

treatment-v5 duplicate string regression (7 vs treatment-v4 at 2) follows the same pattern — later conditions implement more endpoint-specific error messages not yet extracted to named constants in the specification.
